intent: A red CI baseline no longer blocks a commit or push that touches only dependency-pin files, so a pin bump can fix a red freshness gate.
scope: meta/scripts/check_ci_green.sh: PIN_FILE_RE, changed_files, only_pin_files and the exemption branch
Non-goal: any other bypass; everything else stays fail-closed on a red baseline
changes: On a red baseline the hook exits 0 when every changed file is .fvmrc, pubspec.yaml/.lock, package.json, pnpm-lock.yaml, requirements*.txt or pyproject.toml, and prints an EXEMPTION FIRED line listing them
Scope is the push range (PRE_COMMIT_FROM_REF..TO_REF) when set, else the staged files; empty or unusable scope is not exempt

verification.evidence: 8/8 ok: green passes, red blocks code, empty scope, pin-only exempt, mixed blocked, lookalikes blocked, push range, bad range fails closed

risks: A pin-only change can still break the build; the pre-push CI mirror and CI itself remain the guard
A poisoned pin file is exempt from the red-baseline check only, not from other hooks
rollback: git revert the commit; the hook returns to blocking every commit on a red baseline
Validate by running bats linux_configuration/tests/test_check_ci_green.bats is gone and the hook still passes on green
